function first<T>(input: [T?]): T { return input[0]!; }
function firstRest<T>(input: [T?, ...T[]]): T { return input[0]!; }
function firstObject<T>(input: {value?:T}): T { return input.value!; }
function list<T = string>(input: [T?]): T[] { return []; }
function head<A extends unknown[], T = string>(input: [...A,T?]): T[] { return []; }
function union<T>(input: string | T): T[] { return []; }
function literalUnion<T>(input: 'first' | T): T[] { return []; }
const value: string = first([undefined]);
const restValue: string = firstRest([undefined]);
const objectValue: string = firstObject({value:undefined});
const listWrong: string[] = list([undefined]);
const tupleWrong: string[] = head([1, undefined]);
const suffixWrong: number[] = head([undefined]);
const unionWrong: number[] = union('a');
const literalWrong: number[] = literalUnion('first');
console.log(value.toUpperCase());
const w=union('a');
const bad:'a'[]=w;
function read<T>(box: {a: T | undefined}): T { return box.a!; }
const explicitValue: number = read({a: undefined});
console.log(explicitValue.toFixed(2));
